summary: operational hygiene: runbook completion + Tailscale ACL audit doc
description:
Finishes deploy/README.md's admin-runbook section.  The earlier infra tickets (03c0d49e, 6cedb4d0) added their own runbook entries; this fills the gaps and makes the runbook self-contained.

In scope (BRD §2.2):
  - Add or remove an admin (edit ADMIN_USER_IDS, restart guru-web).
  - Reach the admin UI (tailnet hostname; Tailscale-down fallback = ssh + psql).
  - Caddy admin-listener install procedure (cross-ref to 03c0d49e's section).
  - Tailscale cert renewal: where the script lives, where the timer's status is, the one-command manual renewal (cross-ref to 03c0d49e).
  - Tailscale ACL state + how to audit it from the tailnet admin console.
  - Cross-references to the post-deploy smoke checks from BRD §1.17.

Out of scope (deferred to a separate BRD-operator-mutations.md):
  - psql snippets for tier flip, quota reset, soft-delete, kill-switch.

Done when:
  - A new operator (or future-you, six months later) can take the runbook cold and stand up a fresh admin without reading the BRDs.
  - Every operator-action mentioned across 03c0d49e–08288d08 has a corresponding runbook entry.

Tests: none (docs).

resolution.note: deploy/README.md gains an 'Admin UI runbook' section: add/remove admin, reach the UI, Tailscale ACL audit, post-deploy smoke checks (curl matrix + symptom→fix table), cross-refs to cert renewal and operator-mutations BRD. New operator can deploy admin onto fresh VPS reading runbook cold.
